Provide estimated total payable amount. So we need to compute cost. But we also need to consider insurance? Not mentioned. So just cost.

But we need to get the flight cost. We need to call get_flight_cost. That requires travel_from, travel_to, travel_date, travel_class. We can get list of airports. Let's do that.
